title: Question 16
passage:
The test bench just lost power, but the lights are still on.
A. We ordered those lights on Tuesday. B. I’ll check the outlet before we start the next test. C. You can turn the lights off when you leave.
passageZh:
測試台剛斷電，但照明還亮著。
A. 那些燈是我們星期二訂的。 B. 開始下一項測試前，我先檢查插座。 C. 你離開時可以把燈關掉。
